name: Adept JYS (Jump Your Steps)
plain: Hand-built timestep ladder in phases: 1000→600 fast, 600→300, 300→200 dense, then the rest. It is a heuristic ladder computed from step count, not an optimised table.
math:
t from _compute_jys_timesteps; u=(1000−t)/1000. Sorted.
Unless noted: σ_max ≤ 1 uses σ=σmax+u(σmin−σmax); otherwise Karras mapping with ρ=7 and u as ramp. Then 0.

props.shape: ramp warp mapped through Karras or linear

label: from code
